newsitem.title: USA: Worldwide Leisure sets private offering.
newsitem.headline: Worldwide Leisure sets private offering.

text.p: Worldwide Leisure Corp said Wednesday it will launch a private placement of $11 million of convertible preferred securities.
The offering will consist of 110 units at $100,000 and will pay 11 percent interest, the company said. Proceeds will be used to implement Worldwide Leisure's acquisitions program.
The securities will not be registered under the Securities Act of 1933 and therefore may not be offered or sold in the United States without registration or an applicable exemption, the company said.
